manual_review: Building, astronaut, icon and corridor contact sheets inspected.
3x3 corridor join raster and 3x3 terrain repetition inspected.
Moon and Mars assembly previews inspected.
limitations: Unity Editor is not available here: importer, scene placement, runtime sorting and animation playback in Unity still require an integration smoke test.
AI illustration preserves the reference family, not a pixel-for-pixel reconstruction.
Directional frames are distinct and baseline-aligned; small pose/helmet differences remain.
Mirrored texture period is seamless but can become recognizable on large maps.
Bitmap font is uppercase A-Z, digits and a small punctuation subset.
